description: Jobs from Naukri.com, India's largest job board, by keyword and city: title, company, AmbitionBox rating, experience range in years, skills, and (with details) the full description, salary in rupees, industry, department and qualifications. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/naukri-jobs-scraper on your Apify account (about $0.0015 per job; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

date_posted_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

include_details.description: Open each job for the full description, salary, industry and qualifications. Off = faster, search-card fields only.

location.description: City in India, e.g. "Bangalore", "Pune", "Delhi NCR". Empty = all of India.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 500). Cost scales with this.

query.description: Job title, skill or company, e.g. "python developer".

name: search_naukri_jobs

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search Naukri.com jobs (India)
